ctx.x: Yeah. They were playing the Shady Rest in Newark, big place, packed. They opened at 9:00, I got there about 9:30. When I got there I had put my uniform on, Dickie Wells come up with my book under his arm, and his on. I said, here's your new trombone player.
How long were you with Basie then?
